original_heading: The Church Is to Follow the Saviour’s Rule, August 19
verse: First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.—Matthew 5:24.
title: Unity Built on Humility and Love
bullets: Church leaders must model the love and respect they wish to see, guarding against envy, gossip, and bitterness that poison the church family.
When conflicts arise, we should first examine our own hearts for pride and selfishness before pointing fingers at others.
True greatness in God's kingdom comes from humble service and willingness to sacrifice personal desires for the peace and purity of the church.

hymn.title: Blest Be the Tie That Binds

prayer: Lord, help me to be a peacemaker in my church and home, examining my own heart before judging others. Give me the courage to stop gossip, the humility to seek reconciliation, and the love to put the unity of Your body above my own reputation or desires.
